Reference / http/token

http/token#

Tokens (RFC 9110 §5.6.2): the words of HTTP.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

HttpToken("X-Trace").string();
HttpToken("two words");                 // InvalidToken

Description#

Tokens (RFC 9110 §5.6.2): the words of HTTP. Methods, field names, codings, media types and cookie names are tokens.

Public API#

object HttpToken#

object HttpToken

A token of RFC 9110 §5.6.2: one or more tchar. Methods, field names, codings, media types and cookie names are tokens. Checked at construction.

HttpToken.HttpToken#

HttpToken(origin is string)

Checks origin: one or more tchar; InvalidToken otherwise.

HttpToken.string#

string() is string

The token.
